title: Persona copy says seekers to members and promises loyalty rewards that are not built
detail: PR 4 (ADR-1715). lib/onboarding/example-sequences.ts: How should seekers find you becomes How should people find you, and connect you to people near you. lib/onboarding/personas.ts: the Community builder label becomes Host or organizer (it collides with the Builders family), the Partner reel drops the loyalty rewards and gamified foot traffic promise until it ships, and the Practitioner track points at the coaches door or /spaces instead of /the-quest. Persona ids, tags, segments and sequences stay.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(p)=>{try{return fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")}catch{return ""}};const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};if(/seekers/i.test(r("lib/onboarding/example-sequences.ts")))fail("example sequences tell members about seekers");const p=r("lib/onboarding/personas.ts");if(/loyalty/i.test(p))fail("a persona promises loyalty rewards, which are not built");if(/label:\s*"?.Community builder/.test(p))fail("the persona label Community builder collides with the Builders family");if(/the-quest/.test(p))fail("the Practitioner track still links to /the-quest")'
verify.note: Fails while example sequences say seekers, a persona promises loyalty rewards, the Community builder label stands, or the Practitioner track links to /the-quest.
